content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for SAI Section Officer Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.sportsauthorityofindia.nic.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 08-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the SAI Section Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the SAI Section Officer recruitment is 08 October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Section Officer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Section Officer post will receive a salary in the pay scale of Rs. 44900 - 142400 Per Month, corresponding to Level-07.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for applying to this post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applying to the Section Officer post is 56 years. There are no specific age relaxations mentioned in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the Section Officer position at SAI?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. What are the minimum qualifications required for the Section Officer role?
faq.answer: Candidates must be officers working under Central/State/UT Governments holding an analogous post in Level-07 or have 5 years of regular service in Level-06.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the SAI Section Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies for the Section Officer post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 20 vacancies announced for the Section Officer post by the Sports Authority of India.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is Deputation, meaning eligible government officers can apply for these positions.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Sports Authority of India located?
faq.answer: The Sports Authority of India is located in New Delhi, with the pincode 110003.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Section Officer position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Section Officer position at the Sports Authority of India will be based on an Interview.
